title.narrative: Förderung von Jugendzentren für eine jugendzentrierte Entwicklung in Indien
Supporting youth centres for youth-centred development in India

description.narrative: Many young people in rural regions of India have limited access to good education, career prospects and opportunities to participate in public life. Economic insecurity, social disadvantage and traditional role models make personal development particularly difficult for young women. At the same time, there is great potential, as young people strive for guidance, qualifications and participation, but are often unable to realise this.
